main_measure.name: share of positive next-bar returns on bars with forecast >= 16 minus all-bar share, pooled over coins
main_measure.threshold: confirm if hit-rate excess > 0 with z >= 2, reject if excess < 0 with z <= -2, over at least 100 qualifying bars; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean next-bar return on qualifying bars minus mean of all bars (Welch t)

decided_by: Confirm rule met: the hit-rate excess is positive with z >= 2 over at least 100 qualifying bars.
reading: Qualifying bars and the baseline (all bars with a next close in the same window) are each pooled over all coins and windows, a positive return is strictly > 0, the baseline includes the qualifying bars, the supporting check has no threshold so its passed is null, and the plan's '<100 bars' case is reported as not observable per the instructions.
